Ms. Nisha Dhami, Advocate, holding brief of Mr. B.S. Koranga, Advocate, for the applicant.
Mr. Deepak Bhatt, Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand/1.

The present C482 application arises out of the matrimonial dispute, which has emanated from the FIR No.230, dated 08.09.2019, as registered by the complainant/respondent no.2, against the present applicants for their involvement in the commission of the offences under sections 498A,
323, 504 and 506 of IPC, and under section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

Upon submission of the Chargesheet No.01, dated 03.02.2020, the cognizance has been taken by the court of Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar, in Criminal Case No.191 of 2021, "State Vs. Mohd Farman", whereby the present applicant has been summoned for the offences under sections 498A, 504 and 506 of IPC, and under section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the allegation which had been levelled with regards to the incident which is said to have chanced on 10.10.2018, but the FIR has been registered at a much belated stage, and hence no sanctity could be attached to the allegations levelled in the FIR.

Coupled with the fact that so far as the offence under section 323 of IPC, is concerned, which has been levelled in the FIR, and later on excluded by the Judicial Magistrate, is not an offence which could be culled out from the FIR or from the chargesheet.

Apart from it, it has been argued that if the summoning order is taken into consideration, the same is without application of mind, and it doesn't assigned any reasons justifying the summoning of the accused persons in the Criminal Case No.191 of 2021, "State Vs. Mohd Farman".
Since the entire controversy relates to the matrimonial dispute, which is civil in nature, there could be a possibility of the settlement, which could be ventured by this Court by calling upon the parties to appear in person, to make an effort for mediation.

C482/1638/2023 on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69761204/
1
Issue notices to the respondent no.2.
Steps to be taken by the applicant within a week from today.
Respondents may file their counter affidavit within a period of three weeks.

Till the next date of listing, the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.191 of 2021, "State Vs. Mohd Farman", pending consideration before the court of Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar, would be permitted to be adjourned at the request of the applicant.
